verdict.rationale: Cold-start latency is a fair question for a local inference runtime like Ollama, but the evidence pack has no first-party claim about fast startup or a lightweight runtime binary. Community items describe convenient model hot-swapping and per-token throughput, which are not cold-start time. One user report says it "takes a long while before it starts giving a result," which cuts against the story rather than supporting it.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can get a fast cold start from a lightweight runtime binary instead of waiting seconds before inference begins
